verdict.rationale: The pack shows some signs of a third-party ecosystem: OpenRouter routes to Gemini models, Artificial Analysis lists Gemini throughout its independent leaderboard, and Google ships skills aimed at third-party coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor. The OpenAI-library compatibility also lets OpenAI-based tooling target Gemini. Beyond these thin mentions, nothing shows a broad, actively maintained community ecosystem. Missing for 10: curated community lists, evidence of third-party integrations and tools with active maintainers, breadth of the router and integration landscape, independent corroboration that the ecosystem is thriving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the community ecosystem around the model is genuinely alive — curated lists, third-party tools, routers, and integrations with active maintainers
